adjudication.rationale: The diff shows that in admin_group_route.js, the code was changed from using afterModel (which returns a promise and is part of the route's promise chain) to calling model.findMembers() directly in setupController without returning or awaiting it. This means the async operation runs outside the route's error handling - if findMembers() fails, the route won't catch the error and will render with empty/stale data. The finding correctly identifies this as a real issue where network failures become invisible to the route's error handling.
